analysis:
At the UNGA on 27 September 2019 the PM said 37 crore new bank accounts were added in five years. BOOM checked this against the PMJDY dashboard, which showed 37.05 crore beneficiaries on 18 September 2019, and rated it true.

The figure counts accounts opened under the scheme; it does not measure how many are active or whether every household is covered, a point fact-checkers raised about a related manifesto claim.
notes: Quote taken from BOOM's rendering of the speech, so verbatim status not confirmed against the official transcript. Factly and FactChecker pages were seen only in search summaries (FactChecker page partly fetched). No video located. The Jan Dhan 'every family' claim is a different claim.
